ev.q: Three of the four confirmed cases were in men in their 70s, and one was in a woman in her 50s.
Three patients were hospitalized (range 1–3 days), and all recovered from their illness.
Three patients reported experiencing a biphasic illness
Symptom onset in all four patients was in May, and all had fever
All patients reported spending ≥5 hours per day outdoors
CDC and Oregon health officials conducted an investigation to describe the clinical course, exposures, and geographic distribution of patients
The four patients were residents of three neighboring counties, and all accessed care at the same health care system in one county.

methods_quotes.q: Information was collected through medical record review and phone interview.
A suspected CTF case was defined as fever and leukopenia with no alternative explanation in a patient evaluated during April 15–July 31, 2018.
were searched using the International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision codes for fever and leukopenia
